What would be the most significant advice you could offer to those aiming to reach their health and fitness objectives?
"Going to the gym alone can be intimidating, approaching something new alone can be tricky. But when you start meeting those people they become your friends and it just becomes another story. I had a subscriber who just turned 40 and she lost so much weight. She had a bachelorette party and all of her girlfriends were like 'when are we going to the gym?
